description: Tool to update an existing GA4 Property. Use when you need to modify property settings such as display name, time zone, currency code, or industry category.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating a GA4 Property.

currencyCode.description: The currency type used in reports involving monetary values. Format: ISO 4217. Examples: 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for this property. The max allowed display name length is 100 UTF-16 code units.
displayName.title: Display Name

name.description: Required. The resource name of the Property to update. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id} where property_id is a numeric identifier. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain no forward slashes in the property_id, have no trailing slashes, and no additional path segments. Valid example: 'properties/489591273'. Invalid examples: '489591273' (missing prefix), 'properties/489591273/' (trailing slash), 'properties/489591273/extra' (extra segments)
name.title: Name

parent.description: Immutable. Resource name of this property's logical parent. Format: accounts/{account}, properties/{property}. Example: 'accounts/100', 'properties/101'
parent.title: Parent

timeZone.description: Required. Reporting Time Zone, used as the day boundary for reports. Format: IANA time zone. Example: 'America/Los_Angeles'
timeZone.title: Time Zone

updateMask.description: Required. The list of fields to be updated. Field names must be in snake case (e.g., 'display_name', 'time_zone', 'currency_code'). Omitted fields will not be updated. To replace the entire entity, use one path with the string '*' to match all fields. Common fields: 'display_name', 'time_zone', 'currency_code', 'industry_category'
updateMask.title: Update Mask

inputSchema.title: UpdatePropertyRequest

name: update_property

UpdatePropertyResponse.description: Response model for UpdateProperty action representing an updated GA4 Property resource.

account.description: Immutable. The resource name of the parent account. Format: accounts/{account_id}. Example: 'accounts/123'
account.title: Account

createTime.description: Output only. Time when the entity was originally created.
createTime.title: Create Time

currencyCode.description: The currency type used in reports involving monetary values. Format: ISO 4217. Examples: 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

deleteTime.description: Output only. If set, the time at which this property was trashed. If not set, then this property is not currently in the trash can.
deleteTime.title: Delete Time

displayName.description: Required. Human-readable display name for this property. The max allowed display name length is 100 UTF-16 code units.
displayName.title: Display Name

expireTime.description: Output only. If set, the time at which this trashed property will be permanently deleted. If not set, then this property is not currently in the trash can and is not slated to be deleted.
expireTime.title: Expire Time

industryCategory.description: Industry associated with this property. Example: AUTOMOTIVE, FOOD_AND_DRINK
industryCategory.title: Industry Category

name.title: Name

parent.title: Parent

propertyType.title: Property Type

serviceLevel.description: Output only. The Google Analytics service level that applies to this property.
